title: Universal Feature Graph IR (deed meaning substrate) — first leg
repo_context: Backend-only feature graph IR, persistence, compiler/judge, and API endpoints running parallel to legacy pipelines.

stories.title: Create core Feature Graph IR models
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic models for FeatureKind, FeatureNode, FeatureEdge, FeatureRef, OpExpr, Literal, FeatureGraph exist under `backend/feature_graph/`.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_models.py` passes and asserts JSON round-trip for a minimal graph.
stories.notes: Ensure representability is total and no confidence scores are introduced.

stories.title: Add provenance + citation models and attach to nodes
acceptance_criteria: Provenance models (TextSpan, Citation, EvidenceRef) exist and are referenced by FeatureNode/FeatureEdge.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_provenance.py` passes with citation round-trip coverage.
stories.notes: Citations must point to text spans and evidence links.

stories.title: Define gap types and judge report models
acceptance_criteria: Gap types include MissingAnchor, MissingOperand, MissingParameter, AmbiguousChoice, UnsupportedOperation.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_gaps.py` passes and validates JSON serialization.
stories.notes: Gap records must be deterministic and carry citations.

stories.title: Add operation registry for universal constructors
acceptance_criteria: Operation definitions include Traverse/LineStep/CurveStep/ConstraintStep, Derive ops, Constraint ops, and Region booleans.
Unsupported ops can be stored as UnsupportedOperation entries.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_operations.py` passes.
stories.notes: IR must accept ops it cannot execute.

stories.title: Define artifact models for IR/compile/judge/bundle
acceptance_criteria: Artifact models include IR Artifact, Compile Artifact, Judge Report, and Bundle Artifact with lineage fields.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_artifacts.py` passes with round-trip coverage.
stories.notes: Artifacts must be durable and rehydratable.

stories.title: Add feature graph artifact persistence service + paths
acceptance_criteria: New paths exist for feature graph artifacts and index under `config.paths`.
FeatureGraphPersistenceService writes artifacts atomically and maintains an index.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_persistence.py` passes using temp roots.
stories.notes: Keep artifacts separate from legacy schema/georef artifacts.

stories.title: Add IR artifact API endpoints
acceptance_criteria: New router `backend/api/endpoints/feature_graph.py` exposes save/get/list/list-all for IR artifacts.
`pytest backend/api/test_feature_graph_ir_endpoints.py` passes with basic CRUD responses.
stories.notes: Endpoints must be separate from legacy pipelines.

stories.title: Implement local traverse compiler for LineStep
acceptance_criteria: Compile produces local polyline output for Traverse LineSteps with numeric distance/bearing.
Missing numeric parameters emit MissingParameter gaps instead of failing.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_compiler_traverse.py` passes.
stories.notes: Local compile only; anchoring to global frames remains optional.

stories.title: Support Close derive (and stub Buffer) in compiler
acceptance_criteria: Close(curve) produces a Region only when curve is closed; otherwise returns a MissingParameter or UnsupportedOperation gap.
Buffer(...) emits UnsupportedOperation with structured params.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_compiler_derive.py` passes.

stories.title: Add deterministic judge engine for typed gaps
acceptance_criteria: Judge engine returns gap records for missing anchors, operands, parameters, and unsupported ops.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_judge.py` passes with deterministic outputs.
stories.notes: No confidence scores; gaps must include citations/evidence links.

stories.title: Implement bundle/freeze operation for portability
acceptance_criteria: Bundle operation exports IR + minimal dependency subgraph and records why each dependency was included.
`pytest backend/feature_graph/test_bundle.py` passes.
stories.notes: Bundle artifacts must be standalone and portable.

stories.title: Add compile/judge/bundle API endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Feature graph router exposes compile/judge/bundle endpoints with deterministic JSON outputs.
`pytest backend/api/test_feature_graph_compile_endpoints.py` passes.
stories.notes: Keep routes separate from legacy pipelines and use feature graph artifacts.
